# index.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#080a09">
<title>Anuj Routh — Agriculture · Technology · Entrepreneurship</title>
<meta name="description" content="Portfolio of Anuj Routh — an undergraduate student exploring agriculture, technology, AI, and entrepreneurship.">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#080a09;--bg2:#0c0f0d;--surface:#101310;--surface2:#141814;
  --line:rgba(236,241,237,.09);--line2:rgba(236,241,237,.15);
  --text:#f0f2ef;--muted:#9aa29b;--muted2:#6f776f;
  --green:#68c77b;--green2:#8bd998;--max:1180px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.36;background-image:linear-gradient(var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:80px 80px;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,black 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.6) 55%,transparent 100%);z-index:-3}
body:after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:-2;background:radial-gradient(circle at 76% 12%,rgba(104,199,123,.07),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 12% 48%,rgba(104,199,123,.035),transparent 26%)}
::selection{background:rgba(104,199,123,.3);color:#fff}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit}
.container{width:min(calc(100% - 48px),var(--max));margin:auto}
.nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:20;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:.4s var(--ease);background:rgba(8,10,9,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.nav.scrolled{border-color:var(--line);background:rgba(8,10,9,.88)}
.nav-inner{height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.brand{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-size:16px}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:26px;align-items:center}
.nav-links a{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);transition:.25s}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.nav-toggle{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.nav-toggle span,.nav-toggle span:before,.nav-toggle span:after{display:block;width:18px;height:1px;background:currentColor;position:relative;margin:auto;transition:.3s}
.nav-toggle span:before,.nav-toggle span:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0}
.nav-toggle span:before{top:-6px}.nav-toggle span:after{top:6px}
.hero{min-height:100svh;padding:140px 0 74px;display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:80px;align-items:center;width:100%}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;color:var(--green2);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:650}
.eyebrow:before{content:"";width:62px;height:1px;background:var(--green)}
h1{font-size:clamp(48px,7.3vw,94px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:28px 0 30px;max-width:850px;font-weight:720}
h1 .accent{color:var(--green)}
.lede{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,21px);line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted);max-width:710px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid var(--line2);padding:12px 17px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;transition:transform .25s var(--ease),background .25s,border-color .25s;cursor:pointer}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(104,199,123,.5)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--green);color:#071009;border-color:var(--green)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--green2)}
.btn-secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.hero-portrait{justify-self:end;position:relative;width:min(390px,100%);aspect-ratio:4/5}
.portrait-frame{position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:#111;transform:rotate(1.5deg);transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
.hero-portrait:hover .portrait-frame{transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-5px)}
.portrait-frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(104,199,123,.13),transparent 35%,transparent 70%,rgba(0,0,0,.5));pointer-events:none}
.portrait{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.04);transform:scale(1.01)}
.portrait-tag{position:absolute;left:-24px;bottom:24px;z-index:2;background:rgba(13,16,14,.92);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 15px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.portrait-tag small{display:block;color:var(--muted2);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase}
.portrait-tag strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:13px}
.scroll-note{position:absolute;bottom:28px;left:0;color:var(--muted2);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.scroll-note:after{content:"";width:45px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
section{padding:120px 0;position:relative}
.section-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.7fr 1.3fr;gap:50px;margin-bottom:58px}
.section-index{color:var(--green);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;padding-top:8px}
h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,62px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0;font-weight:700}
.section-copy{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;max-width:720px}
.about-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(255,255,255,.015));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;transition:.35s var(--ease)}
.panel:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--line2)}
.panel h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.panel p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.statement{font-size:clamp(26px,3.5vw,44px);line-height:1.17;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.statement span{color:var(--green)}
.timeline{position:relative;margin-top:20px}
.timeline:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:var(--line2)}
.timeline-item{position:relative;padding:0 0 42px 48px}
.timeline-dot{position:absolute;left:7px;top:8px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--green)}
.timeline-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:25px 26px}
.meta{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--green2);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;margin-bottom:10px}
.timeline-card h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.timeline-card .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:13px}
.timeline-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.exp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.exp-card{min-height:250px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.exp-no{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted2);letter-spacing:.15em}
.exp-card h3{font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 10px}
.exp-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin:0}
.tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.tag{font-size:11px;color:#bfc7c0;border:1px solid var(--line2);padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.skill-block{padding:32px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface)}
.skill-block h3{margin:0 0 22px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2)}
.skill-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.skill{padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;font-size:14px;transition:.25s}
.skill:hover{border-color:rgba(104,199,123,.55);transform:translateY(-2px);color:var(--green2)}
.building{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);position:relative}
.building-top{padding:46px 44px 38px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.building h3{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,62px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:0 0 18px}
.building p{color:var(--muted);max-width:650px;font-size:16px;margin:0}
.building-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.stage{padding:28px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.stage:last-child{border-right:0}
.stage-no{font-size:11px;color:var(--green);letter-spacing:.2em}
.stage h4{margin:12px 0 6px;font-size:18px}
.stage p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted2);margin:0}
.stage:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:18px;top:50%;width:25px;height:1px;background:var(--line2)}
.stage:last-child:after{display:none}
.vision{padding-top:80px}
.vision-card{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:26px;padding:60px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .8fr;gap:60px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 90% 20%,rgba(104,199,123,.08),transparent 32%),var(--surface)}
.vision-card h3{font-size:clamp(38px,5.5vw,72px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:0}
.vision-card h3 span{color:var(--green)}
.vision-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;align-self:end;margin:0}
.philosophy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.philosophy-quote{padding:38px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface);font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,39px);line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.philosophy-quote span{color:var(--green)}
.principles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden}
.principle{padding:22px;background:var(--bg2)}
.principle strong{display:block;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px}
.principle span{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted2)}
.contact{padding-bottom:70px}
.contact-card{min-height:410px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:26px;padding:54px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(104,199,123,.06),transparent 45%),var(--surface)}
.contact-card h2{max-width:800px}
.contact-card p{color:var(--muted);max-width:600px;font-size:16px}
.footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:28px 0 38px;color:var(--muted2);font-size:12px}
.footer-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.hero-copy>*{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);animation:heroIn .85s var(--ease) forwards}
.hero-copy .eyebrow{animation-delay:.05s}.hero-copy h1{animation-delay:.14s}.hero-copy .lede{animation-delay:.23s}.hero-copy .hero-actions{animation-delay:.32s}
.hero-portrait{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px) scale(.98);animation:heroPortrait 1s var(--ease) .18s forwards}
@keyframes heroIn{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes heroPortrait{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}
.portrait-frame{animation:drift 6s ease-in-out infinite}
.cursor-dot{position:fixed;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);pointer-events:none;z-index:50;mix-blend-mode:screen;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
@media (pointer:fine){body.has-cursor .cursor-dot{opacity:.65}}
@media(max-width:900px){
 .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:50px}.hero-portrait{justify-self:start;width:min(350px,82vw)}
 .section-head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}.about-layout,.exp-grid,.skills-grid,.philosophy{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .vision-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px;padding:40px}.building-bottom{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .stage:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.stage:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.stage:nth-child(odd):after{display:block}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
 .container{width:min(calc(100% - 30px),var(--max))}.nav-links{position:absolute;top:72px;left:15px;right:15px;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:10px;background:rgba(12,15,13,.97);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:16px}
 .nav-links.open{display:flex}.nav-links a{padding:12px 14px}.nav-toggle{display:block}
 .hero{padding-top:118px}h1{font-size:clamp(45px,14vw,70px)}section{padding:85px 0}
 .scroll-note{display:none}.portrait-tag{left:10px;bottom:14px}.timeline:before{left:8px}.timeline-item{padding-left:32px}.timeline-dot{left:3px}
 .timeline-card,.panel,.skill-block{padding:22px}.building-top{padding:32px 24px}.building-bottom{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .stage{border-right:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)!important}.stage:last-child{border-bottom:0!important}
 .stage:after{display:none!important}.vision-card,.contact-card{padding:32px 24px}.contact-card{min-height:350px}
 .footer-inner{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.cursor-dot{display:none}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="cursor-dot" id="cursor"></div>
<header class="nav" id="nav">
  <div class="container nav-inner">
    <a class="brand" href="#home">Anuj Routh</a>
    <button class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" aria-label="Open navigation" aria-expanded="false"><span></span></button>
    <nav class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
      <a href="#about">About</a><a href="#education">Education</a><a href="#experience">Experience</a>
      <a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#vision">Vision</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<section class="hero" id="home">
  <div class="container hero-grid">
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <div class="eyebrow">Anuj Routh</div>
      <h1>Building ideas at the intersection of <span class="accent">agriculture</span>, technology &amp; entrepreneurship.</h1>
      <p class="lede">I'm an undergraduate Political Science student, a technology and AI enthusiast, and an aspiring Agribusiness and AgriTech entrepreneur. Right now I'm learning, experimenting and steadily building the skills for the career I want to create.</p>
      <div class="hero-actions">
        <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#about">Explore My Journey <span>↗</span></a>
        <a class="btn btn-secondary" href="#about">About Me</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-portrait" aria-label="Portrait of Anuj Routh">
      <div class="portrait-frame">
        <img class="portrait" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Anuj Routh">
      </div>
      <div class="portrait-tag"><small>Currently</small><strong>Learning · Experimenting · Building</strong></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="container scroll-note">Scroll to explore</div>
</section>

<section id="about">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">01 / About</div><div><h2>Curiosity is where the journey starts.</h2><p class="section-copy">I like understanding how things work — then asking what could be done differently. My interests sit across technology, business, agriculture and personal development, with a long-term ambition to turn that curiosity into something of my own.</p></div></div>
    <div class="about-layout">
      <div class="panel reveal"><h3>A learner by nature.</h3><p>I'm still building my knowledge and skills, not presenting myself as an expert. Every new idea, tool, mistake and experiment is part of learning how to think better and create with more confidence.</p></div>
      <div class="panel reveal"><h3>Building toward independence.</h3><p>The long-term goal is an independent career and eventually an agribusiness that brings agriculture, technology and entrepreneurship together in a meaningful, scalable way.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel reveal" style="margin-top:18px"><p class="statement">The direction is simple: <span>learn deeply</span>, adapt quickly, stay persistent, and keep moving toward bigger ideas.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="education">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">02 / Education</div><div><h2>Learning how people, systems &amp; decisions shape the world.</h2><p class="section-copy">My degree gives me a broader foundation in institutions, society, governance, critical thinking and decision-making — skills I want to carry into future business and entrepreneurial work.</p></div></div>
    <div class="timeline reveal">
      <div class="timeline-item">
        <span class="timeline-dot"></span>
        <div class="timeline-card">
          <div class="meta"><span>2025 — 2029</span><span>Undergraduate</span></div>
          <h3>Bachelor of Arts (Honours) — Political Science</h3>
          <div class="sub">Surya Sen Mahavidyalaya · Affiliated with University of North Bengal</div>
          <p>Expected graduation: 2029. Building a foundation in political science while independently exploring technology, AI, agriculture, business and entrepreneurship.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="experience">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">03 / Experience</div><div><h2>Early experiences that taught me how work actually happens.</h2><p class="section-copy">My experience so far has been practical and grounded — showing up, taking responsibility, working with people and adapting to what the situation demands.</p></div></div>
    <div class="exp-grid">
      <article class="panel exp-card reveal"><div><div class="exp-no">01 / PART-TIME</div><h3>Retail clothing store</h3><p>Worked part-time during a summer break, gaining practical exposure to a retail environment, customer interaction, responsibility and day-to-day adaptability.</p></div><div class="tags"><span class="tag">Customer interaction</span><span class="tag">Responsibility</span><span class="tag">Adaptability</span></div></article>
      <article class="panel exp-card reveal"><div><div class="exp-no">02 / EVENT OPERATIONS</div><h3>Stock handler · Event organising</h3><p>Worked as a stock handler across two events, helping with organisation, inventory/stock handling, teamwork and physical execution under event-time pressure.</p></div><div class="tags"><span class="tag">Stock handling</span><span class="tag">Teamwork</span><span class="tag">Execution</span></div></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="skills">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">04 / Skills</div><div><h2>Tools, interests and traits I'm developing.</h2><p class="section-copy">These aren't claimed proficiency scores. They are the areas I am actively interested in, learning about and strengthening over time.</p></div></div>
    <div class="skills-grid">
      <div class="skill-block reveal"><h3>Areas of Focus</h3><div class="skill-list"><span class="skill">AI Tools</span><span class="skill">Agriculture</span><span class="skill">Agribusiness</span><span class="skill">AgriTech</span></div></div>
      <div class="skill-block reveal"><h3>Core Strengths</h3><div class="skill-list"><span class="skill">Adaptability</span><span class="skill">Resilience</span><span class="skill">Persistence</span><span class="skill">Curiosity</span><span class="skill">Continuous Learning</span></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="building">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">05 / Projects &amp; Future Work</div><div><h2>The work is just beginning.</h2><p class="section-copy">There are no major completed projects to showcase yet — intentionally. I'm currently learning, experimenting and developing the skills needed to turn future ideas into real-world work.</p></div></div>
    <div class="building reveal">
      <div class="building-top"><h3>Currently <span style="color:var(--green)">building</span>.</h3><p>Exploring the overlap between AI, agriculture, AgriTech, entrepreneurship and technology-driven business. This space is designed to grow as real projects take shape.</p></div>
      <div class="building-bottom">
        <div class="stage"><div class="stage-no">01</div><h4>Learn</h4><p>Build fundamentals and understand the problem.</p></div>
        <div class="stage"><div class="stage-no">02</div><h4>Experiment</h4><p>Test ideas, tools and possible approaches.</p></div>
        <div class="stage"><div class="stage-no">03</div><h4>Build</h4><p>Turn useful ideas into practical projects.</p></div>
        <div class="stage"><div class="stage-no">04</div><h4>Scale</h4><p>Grow what works into something meaningful.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="vision" class="vision">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">06 / Career Vision</div><div><h2>From learning to building.</h2><p class="section-copy">The current stage is preparation. The destination is a future agribusiness where technology isn't an add-on — it is part of how the business thinks, operates and grows.</p></div></div>
    <div class="vision-card reveal">
      <h3><span>Agriculture</span><br>+ Technology<br>+ Entrepreneurship</h3>
      <p>I want to eventually build something independent, useful and scalable — while keeping a peaceful life with my family and continuing to challenge myself with bigger goals. Today's learning is preparation for that future.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="philosophy">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head reveal"><div class="section-index">07 / Philosophy</div><div><h2>A mindset for the long game.</h2></div></div>
    <div class="philosophy">
      <div class="philosophy-quote reveal">Turn <span>curiosity</span> into action. Turn action into learning. Keep going.</div>
      <div class="principles reveal">
        <div class="principle"><strong>Keep learning</strong><span>Stay curious when the answer isn't obvious.</span></div>
        <div class="principle"><strong>Adapt to change</strong><span>Adjust without losing the direction.</span></div>
        <div class="principle"><strong>Build, don't only consume</strong><span>Make ideas tangible whenever possible.</span></div>
        <div class="principle"><strong>Think long-term</strong><span>Choose progress that compounds over time.</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="contact" class="contact">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="contact-card reveal">
      <div><div class="section-index">08 / Contact</div><h2 style="margin-top:18px">More to come.</h2><p>I'm still at the beginning of the journey, but I'm building toward something bigger. Professional contact details and links can be added here when I'm ready to make them public.</p></div>
      <div><span class="tag">A portfolio designed to grow with the journey.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer class="footer">
  <div class="container footer-inner"><span>© <span id="year"></span> Anuj Routh</span><span>Agriculture · Technology · Entrepreneurship</span></div>
</footer>

<script>
const nav=document.getElementById('nav');
const toggle=document.getElementById('navToggle');
const links=document.getElementById('navLinks');
const cursor=document.getElementById('cursor');

window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>20),{passive:true});
toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=links.classList.toggle('open');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open)});
links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>links.classList.remove('open')));

const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach((entry,i)=>{
    if(entry.isIntersecting){
      entry.target.style.transitionDelay=(i%4)*70+'ms';
      entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      observer.unobserve(entry.target);
    }
  });
},{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));

document.getElementById('year').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();

if(matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
  document.body.classList.add('has-cursor');
  window.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{cursor.style.left=e.clientX+'px';cursor.style.top=e.clientY+'px'});
}

document.querySelectorAll('.btn,.skill,.panel,.timeline-card,.building,.vision-card,.contact-card').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>{if(matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches) cursor.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.8)'});
  el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{cursor.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)'});
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
